page: Microsoft Azure E8as_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the Eav6 series, powered by AMD EPYC 9V74 processors on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The configuration provides 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 4 physical cores with multithreading at clock speeds reaching 3.7 GHz. System memory totals 64.0 GB, establishing a generous 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio. The underlying x86_64 architecture features 32 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, 32 MB of shared L3 cache, and instruction support including AVX-512, SHA-NI, and VAES cryptographic extensions. No local ephemeral disks are bundled, requiring attached network storage for persistent or temporary file systems, and no physical hardware accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses are present.

Benchmark results demonstrate strong single-threaded CPU capability alongside balanced multi-core execution. The processor achieves a strong top-tier single-core rating in stress-ng (3080.72) and a Geekbench single-core score of 1981.0, paired with solid text processing results (2656.0). Multi-threaded compute yields mid-tier marks, including a Geekbench multi-core score of 7647.0 and a PassMark CPU score of 14455.02. Memory subsystems show cached read bandwidth of 608.08 GB/sec, though uncached large-block read transfers measure at a lower 38.21 GB/sec. Operational throughput remains competitive for service workloads, delivering 11.53 million Redis SET operations per second and 12.24 GB/sec in static web serving benchmarks.

Without integrated local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration, the E8as_v6 balances cost and density primarily around its substantial memory footprint. It delivers predictable compute throughput per core while maintaining sufficient headroom for high-concurrency memory allocations. The instance represents an effective resource match for in-memory caching layers such as Redis, enterprise relational databases dependent on premium remote storage, Java or JVM-based application runtimes, and intermediate ETL data pipeline tasks.
description: Microsoft Azure E8as_v6 is a memory-optimized cloud server powered by AMD EPYC 9V74 processors running on Microsoft Hyper-V. The system provides 8 dedicated vCPUs derived from 4 physical cores at 3.7 GHz, supported by 64.0 GB of memory for an 8.0 GB per vCPU capacity. The x86_64 architecture incorporates 32 MB of L3 cache alongside AVX-512 and cryptographic hardware extensions. It contains zero local storage drives and no GPU acceleration, relying entirely on remote storage volumes for system and data persistence. In synthetic evaluations, the instance posts strong single-core ratings across stress-ng and Geekbench, combined with average multi-threaded and uncached memory bandwidth metrics. Caching performance reaches 11.53 million Redis SET operations per second, making this instance well-suited for medium-scale in-memory databases, memory-bound enterprise applications, structured relational database workloads, and analytics processing.
